thread:
sasha_ops: Heads up — NexaSupply confirmed partial shipment. 20 H100s landed, 5 flagged DOA. Vendor is proposing air-replace for the 5 DOA and ground for the rest. AWB pending. Need routing + cost decision. @mike_procurement @evan_logistics

mike_procurement: Can we get the serials for the 5 DOA and the vendor air quote? Also need clarity on who handles customs/duties if we expedite. Which cost center should this hit?

evans_logistics: If we go air, route to FRA-depot-2 for immediate RMA triage. Estimated ETA 48h after AWB issued. Depot has spare brackets and can swap same-day. Any objections?

anna_platform: Before we push air, what's the failure mode? If it's thermal we might prefer depot repair; if power-on fail, swap is faster. Ops needs logs to triage.

sasha_ops: Vendor summary: "power-on fail / no POST" for the 5 units. I'll pull their run logs and serial list now.

sasha_ops: NexaSupply (vendor msg pasted): Serial list (redacted): H100-RA-01, H100-RA-02, H100-RA-03, H100-RA-04, H100-RA-05. Air quote = $26,000 total + customs. Vendor requests 50% expedite fee share. They prefer depot-to-depot consolidated AWB.

mike_procurement: 50% expedite share is steep. We can offer 25% if vendor covers customs/duties. Ask them to show breakdown: carrier surge vs fuel surcharge vs handling. @evan_logistics any operational concerns?

evans_logistics: I support 25% + vendor covers customs/duties. Also require commercial invoice and pre-alert 12h prior. Send them our RMA labels (depot requires manifest_v2). Example manifest snippet:

```
AWB: TBD
Carrier: TBD
ShipFrom: NexaSupply
ShipTo: FRA-depot-2
Items: 5 x H100 (serials attached)
RMA_type: swap
```

No crossdock allowed without pre-approval.

sasha_ops: Uploaded RMA labels and temp manifest to internal storage: https://files.redwood.internal/rma/1754328889/labels.pdf (placeholder). Customs team recommends HS code 8473.30.00. I asked vendor to confirm HS and include declarant.

anna_platform: If air is approved, I'll enable temporary pool replacements to avoid capacity impact. Spinning up 2x H100 on Dedicated for 24h to cover peak — est cost ~$1.2k/day. Approve?

mike_procurement: Negotiation update: vendor accepted 30% expedite split if we sign the manifest addendum by EOD and provide customs docs. They're asking for AWB number and final PO addendum approval. I'll prepare the addendum.

evans_logistics: Action items:
1) sasha_ops — upload full serials + failure logs by 13:00 CET.
2) mike_procurement — finalize addendum and PO change.
3) evan_logistics — coordinate AWB, confirm carrier (likely LH or TK), schedule depot slot.
SLA target: 72h end-to-end from AWB to depot RMA complete. :thumbsup:

ops_bot: Reminder set — follow up with NexaSupply in 6h if AWB not provided.

sasha_ops: Confirmed I'll post the logs + serial manifest in 20m. Also tagging legal for addendum review: @mike_procurement/legal-review if needed.

mike_procurement: Thanks. If vendor pushes back on customs coverage, escalate to finance. We'll avoid paying full expedite. :thinking:
